87:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(He seems deeply troubled. $$ランド$$ must be getting swept up in a $$リアクター$$'s destiny, too.)

87:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The clash between the $$傷だらけの獅子$$ and the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$... It generated 100Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s. Naturally, I've added them to our stock...)

87:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The $$リアクター$$s are gradually gathering... What will happen when they're all together...?)

87:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Perhaps it will be the worst possible outcome for every world...)

87:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's a pleasure to meet you, $$メール$$. I'm $$ＡＧ$$, $$ＤＥＭ$$'s agent robot.」

87:t_10:29.en:
$$メール$$
「It's a pleasure to meet you, Mr. $$ＡＧ$$. I'm $$メール・ビーター$$, sales representative for the traveling repair outfit, $$ビーター・サービス$$.」

87:t_10:30.en:
$$メール$$
「If your body ever malfunctions, Mr. $$ＡＧ$$, our skilled craftsman will repair it with sincere service and a smile.」

87:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I-I'll pass. If I take one of $$ランド$$'s Heat Smiles, my oil will boil.」

87:t_10:32.en:
$$メール$$
「You mean my darling's charm makes you melt!?」

87:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...You and $$ランド$$ are a perfect match, $$メール$$.」

87:t_10:34.en:
$$メール$$
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$. I think we're going to get along.」

87:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'd appreciate it if a skilled salesgirl like you could help with $$Ｄトレーダー$$, $$メール$$.」

87:t_10:36.en:
$$メール$$
「Sure. I'll watch the store in my spare time.」

87:t_10:37.en:
$$メール$$
「Then let's get started...! Let's get cracking today, too...!」

87:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... I never knew how good it felt to have someone else give me my cue...」

88:t_000:1.en:
$$ラム$$
「The nearby resistance units are drawing the enemy interceptors away.」

88:t_000:3.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「Now we just have to take $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

88:t_000:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...No, it's nothing. Deploy our units.」

88:t_000:10.en:
$$アルト$$
「You've got something on your mind. That's why you led the charge, right?」

88:t_000:11.en:
$$甲児$$
「There's no use hiding it. Lately, your thoughts have started showing on your face.」

88:t_000:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「We've known you a long time. It's nothing surprising.」

88:t_000:14.en:
$$アルト$$
「I don't know what you're planning, but you can rely on us a little, too.」

88:t_000:15.en:
$n
「Sorry... I can't really explain what I'm feeling myself.」

88:t_000:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's fine. We're all part of $c.」

88:t_000:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「Your battle is our battle. We'll all share the burden of your anxiety.」

88:t_000:19.en:
$$スズネ$$
「At times like this, you should say 'thank you,' not 'sorry.'」

88:t_000:21.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's go, $n, everyone. To save the $$アメリア$$ Continent and $$翠の地球$$.」

88:t_000:24.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Enemy interceptors are coming from $$セントラル・ベース$$!」

88:t_001:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「$c...! So you came after all!」

88:t_001:2.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「It's the big showdown, and we're still fighting the same old guy.」

88:t_001:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Heh heh heh... Let's see if you can still joke after seeing these interceptors.」

88:t_001:4.en:
$$クラン$$
「They look like the usual drones and mummy men to me...」

88:t_001:5.en:
$$カナリア$$
「$$ルカ$$, can you tell us anything?」

88:t_001:6.en:
$$ルカ$$
「From the movement data of the $$アンゲロイ$$ types, I believe they're piloted by $$インセクト$$s.」

88:t_001:8.en:
$$ボス$$
「What's that? A meteorite's cousin or something?」

88:t_001:9.en:
$$マオ$$
「I explained this at the briefing. $$インセクト$$s are the artificial soldiers $$サイデリアル$$ uses.」

88:t_001:10.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「They're based on Earth's insects, exploiting their aggression and ability to act as a coordinated group.」

88:t_001:11.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「They're like suicide weapons built purely for attack. All units, be careful.」

88:t_001:12.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Damn it! They're using our planet's wildlife to do whatever they damn well please!」

88:t_001:13.en:
$n
「And turning it into weapons, at that. They're the lowest of the low.」

88:t_001:14.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then there's only one thing to do...!」

88:t_001:15.en:
$$勝平$$
「We'll crush you completely, $$サイデリアル$$!」

88:t_001:16.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Try it, if you can! Don't underestimate this $$セントラル・ベース$$!」

88:t_001:17.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have a significant recommendation.」

88:t_001:18.en:
$$レド$$
「What is it, $$チェインバー#pilot$$?」

88:t_001:19.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The enemy commander is more aggressive than before. I infer that he holds some tactical advantage.」

88:t_001:21.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Indeed, we met little resistance when breaking through their defensive line...」

88:t_001:22.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're saying they lured us in?」

88:t_001:23.en:
$$宗介$$
「But withdrawing now would be even more dangerous.」

88:t_001:25.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Exactly. Remember, many people are counting on us.」

88:t_001:26.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Skull 1 to all units! First, we'll crush their command! Target the enemy ship and $$ギルター$$!」

88:t_001:28.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Come, $c! I'll turn this $$セントラル・ベース$$ into your grave marker!」

88:t_002:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Th-This is bad...! At this rate, I'll...!」

88:t_002:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「Don't worry, $$ギルター$$! You won't be the only one finished. This base is going down, too!」

88:t_002:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「And we'll kick every last one of $$サイデリアル$$ off $$翠の地球$$ while we're at it!」

88:t_002:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Y-You fools...! You should have let me kill you!」

88:t_002:4.en:
$n
「I'm an idiot, but I'm not dumb enough to choose an ending like that.」

88:t_002:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
「In any case, I must retreat!」

88:t_003:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Th-This is bad...! If I take any longer, I'll...」

88:t_003:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「Don't worry, $$ギルター$$! Then we'll finish this right now!」
